_comment: Enchanter (scenes/town/EnchanterScene, EnchantManager). An enchant raises an item one rarity tier and adds the chosen enchantment's bonus. The material picks the effect. Failure loses the gold and materials but never harms the item; each failure adds fail_bonus to the next try on that item (Attuned).
_cost_by_target: Cost and success chance by the rarity the item is raised TO.
_enchants: material: what it costs. stat: attribute bonus (rolled in the item level's stat range). weapon_status: on weapons, a chance to inflict this status (only if the weapon has none yet).
